reviews.text: Everyone here is pleasant, patient & compassionate. The customer service was beyond excellent. I will always take my animals here for care.

Will never come back here again. We were at this facility for 1 hour and 15 minutes, yet we saw the veterinarian for approximately 7 minutes. The rest of the time was spent sitting in a horrible exam room with absolutely no communication or updates.

After I finally had to follow up with the front desk, the technicians came in—only to find out that a team of three technicians was unable to draw a blood sample from our cat. Honestly, is this the first time your team has had to draw blood from a cat?

The level of inefficiency, poor communication, and lack of basic competence was completely unacceptable, especially for a veterinary practice. And to top it off, we were charged the full visit fee for this experience.

Completely unacceptable. We will absolutely not be returning.

As the owner of a newly adopted 1-year-old shelter dog, I would not recommend this place and won't be bringing her back.

The waiting room is very stressful for any dog that's reactive or just getting used to the world outside a shelter. There's just one shared area where dogs are right on top of each other, and there’s no warning when people/dogs walk through the door. They have one small "privacy" nook—basically a short, C-shaped half-wall with a seat inside that's completely open at the top and has no door. It sits right next to where everyone is walking by, so stressed dogs can still hear and smell everything, and it's super easy for them to wiggle right out of it.

The whole appointment felt super rushed and impersonal. They knew I had just brought her home from the shelter, but they didn’t ask about my history with pets/offer any health advice. They didn't talk about her diet, and didn't mention anything about flea, tick, or heart worm prevention. To top it off, they didn't offer a heart worm test while we were there which I was unaware she needed at this time. So when I tried to order her preventative online through their system later, it got denied because she needed that test first—something they easily could have done during her visit. I was disappointed that they hadn’t made me aware of that, as they were holding her records in hand and knew that she needed one.

Between the stressful waiting area and feeling like they just wanted to get us in and out, it wasn't a good experience. If you have a sensitive rescue pet, I'd skip this spot and find a clinic that is hopefully more calming/caring. Maybe the appointments are staggered or waiting rooms more thoughtful.

If your dog is well adjusted and is not afraid of things or dogs or a veterinarian environment— this place is probably fine. But still not the best energy in the world.

Low quality, high cost, private equity pet care. It should be against the law for these massive corporations and investors to do what they do to our pets and wallets.

I was quoted over $4,000 dollars for my dog’s dental procedure that ended up being completed elsewhere for $1,200. Out of convenience, I brought him here post-surgery for his checkups where he was met by under-qualified “doctors” who made guesses, didn’t listen, didn’t look, and overprescribed medication just to put a few extra cents in the pockets of KKR executives. Never had a single confidence-inspiring visit at Mohawk Valley Animal hospital and urge all pet owners to continue searching for reputable independent practices.

Use the free first visit and don’t go back!

My pug has had diarrhea on and off all week. Last night it has a small amount of blood so I made the only appointment available this week and rushed over there. Got stuck in traffic and called the office, they told me as long as I was there by 2:15 I was within the grace period. I walk in at 2:15 with my sick dog and a sample and they tell me it’s a 10 minute grace period. I tell them someone on the phone just told me 15 and they all just looked at me. I asked if they could at least take the sample. They said no and couldn’t get me in for another 4 days. They don’t care about your sick animal here.

I had been taking my dog to this clinic for quite some time, but my experience has left me very disappointed.

Back in April, I spoke with the staff about concerns I had regarding my pet’s care. There were times when procedures or treatments were done without first consulting me, and I made it clear that I expected better communication and transparency.

I also previously brought another dog to this clinic for most of her life. Unfortunately, she was never diagnosed with a heart condition that she ultimately died from. While I understand that not every condition is easy to detect, that experience, combined with my more recent concerns, made me question the level of care and communication I was receiving.

Today, I needed a last-minute appointment, and instead of being met with compassion, the manager was rude and dismissive. I was told that because I had expressed concerns and “didn’t trust them” with my pet’s care, I should take my pet somewhere else. Rather than addressing my concerns professionally or trying to help during a time of need, I felt dismissed as a longtime client.

Good communication, empathy, and respect are essential in veterinary care, especially when families are trusting someone with their beloved pets. Unfortunately, my experience has made me feel that this clinic no longer values those qualities.

We had a great experience taking our cat to her first visit at Mohawk for a first-time wellness exam! I was able to book online which was seamless, and we were seen for our appointment early. The staff was super friendly with our cat and we were able to ask any questions we had while feeling comfortable. Definitely the best vet in the area!
My dog was very well cared for had a surgery for a growth . I was well informed during the day and my beautiful dog was given all the care she needed.  Staff super kind and supportive

My senior cat had several things going on and I loved how Dr. Legaspi immediately prioritized the issues for me to move forward with care. She answered all my questions throughly with metaphors and examples. The front desk and Vet. Tech were efficient and friendly. You know it was a great visit bc my cat was not traumatized at all by the visit.
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We take a lot of pride in delivering the best care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

My dog has chronic pain. And they have suggested to do acupuncture.  I was skeptical at first but the night after her first session I was able to hold my furbaby. After that, we have been coming back to this place. We have been customers for years and despite moving to another city, I will drive back to LA for my baby's wellness.

One time her session was delayed because they accommodated an emergency acupuncture.  I didn't mind. And eventually I found myself in that same predicament,  my dog needed emergency session and they placed me on a standby list and was able to squeeze us in.

They are always full, best to make an appointment.  By that alone, it speaks volume that they are really the best in giving the best care for your pets. Thank you to the staff for being so patient, kind and understanding.
staff has been nothing but kind & helpful & we have never had to wait very long!
The doctors and staff were amazing to our pets!

Best clinic, it was especially great working with Dr. Pacifici! I felt like my cat was so cared for. We also didn’t feel rushed through any of the (many) questions we had during the appointment - every one was treated with care and significance. I also loved that we got to be with him through the whole exam and that the entire room was his to relax in while waiting for the doctor. Would highly recommend!

Great care
Level of attentiveness and attention to detail is unmatched
Everyone was very informative and friendly, I appreciated the care and they way they handled my boy cat Pop.
Friendly, straightforward, and efficient. Parking is a plus!

Dr. Legaspi was amazing, knowledgeable, and explained everything clearly without rushing. My pet Jasper was treated so gently, and I really appreciated how attentive they were to her needs. The clinic itself was clean, organized, and had a really warm vibe. Overall, I left feeling confident that my pet was in good hands. Definitely recommend this place if you’re looking for a vet that actually cares and takes their time with you!

Thank you for the great rating, Nicolas Rodriquez! We're here to provide the best quality care and expertise, and are glad to see we succeeded. Our team appreciates you taking the time to leave us a review!
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We take a lot of pride in delivering the best care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

I’ve unfortunately had a very negative experience in regards of continues treatment question and general inquires of Giardia. In person the vets and staff there a very kind and answered my questions but when it comes to contacting me back once things are no longer face to face it seems like I don’t exist and that the issues I’m facing don’t matter. I am now forced to rely on google and  Reddit on this problem because even though the stool sample says negative for Giardia , the soft almost liquid stool for both cats indicate otherwise. I don’t know why I have to get a prescription for medication for something that is KNOWN to be a difficult thing to get rid of then ghosted when I was reaching out for help , I hope I was just a rare case of they were too busy to deal with me and forgot rather then treating me and both my cats like we don’t matter. I didn’t know getting a prescription for panacure/fenbendazole would be so difficult for a parasite that is incredibly difficult to get rid of :(
Loved taking Cheddar to this spot.  It's quiet and comfortable for the animals with friendly, professional staff.
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We certainly appreciate your trust. We're here to deliver quality veterinary care whenever you need us.
Great place! Treats our pets like family.

March, 2026: This clinic was bought by private equity "about two years ago" according to the vet tech who refused to see us because I was four minutes past their grace period. This was a Sunday at 9:44am, the waiting room was empty, and folks in scrubs were scrolling on their phones behind the swinging door into the back area. In their quest for increased profits and efficiency, Mohawk (or whoever owns them) has sacrificed compassionate and personalized care, become more expensive, and are by no means more efficient. Mandated curbside appointments, long waiting times, rarely the same doctor, delayed relays of lab results because certain doctors aren’t working that day, impersonal, cold, expensive. Expensive like you go to get a hotspot looked at and it’s $430. Sadly there are some great people here—but the finance overlords have ruined it. Will I put my dog between the rock of private equity’s greed and the hard place of medical care? No. I will not.
We’ve been bringing our dog Georgia to Mohawk for 6 years now. We love the friendly staff and overall care. Highly recommend!

All of the staff was welcoming, warm and very patient with our anxious dog.
They were very clear with communication and made sure that we were all in agreement of the treatment plan without any pressure.
Doctors allowed me to be present while examine my pet cat , overall a great positive experience. They treated my cat with care how patience and compassionate the vets were

Absolutely loved the VIP treatment, helping me every step of the way. What I loved most was the vet's communication and the techs' consistent follow-up for 24 hrs.  I also appreciated the kindness upon arrival and the help to usher my dog in for surgery. My pets are my kids, and I trust only the best.  I highly recommend Mohawk Alley.
We really appreciate the rating! We're here to be the best in veterinary care and are glad you had a great experience with us.
We really appreciate the rating! We're here to be the best in veterinary care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

I spent so many hours finding the best vet in LA when I first moved here, and was repeatedly pointed towards Mohawk. I ended up driving the 1+ hour just to bring my dog here, and at first it was exactly what people said it would be! However, over the last year & a half, this place has become absolutely terrible. They used to genuinely care about animals & put their wellbeing at the forefront of their practice, and now they are shameless in putting their profit before anything else- even at the cost of the animals they care for. I write this just so other people looking for a new vet know what they’re getting into by coming here. Would highly recommend looking elsewhere.
I’ve used Mohawk for two of my dogs now for about 6 years. They’re great for local, primary care for the pups and pretty great when you need to work with specialty vets.
Reasonable prices, great communication, great care

Amazing work, great vets and technicians, well run, clean, superb service and very accommodating. She used a treat to distract my cat while giving 3 shots, in an effort to "make going to the vet not traumatic" — my cat didnt even notice she was being poked and that was really great

Appreciate all the staff who have helped with my senior dog pal, both in person and over the phone. I like the honesty when it comes to pricing and services needed and the kindness shown to mr scruffy.

Well, I've never written anything about a place before, but I'm doing this so people are aware of where they take their pets for checkups. I took my dog ​​there because she was very sick and dehydrated. I took her to Mohawk Alley Animal Veterinary Clinic, and honestly, the service was terrible. I don't recommend it because they don't know how to care for animals. According to the vet who saw my dog, she had serious kidney problems and he had to put her down. I asked him why, since they hadn't even treated my dog ​​for dehydration. They just did blood tests, and that's how the doctor decided her kidneys were bad and wanted to put her down. That place is no good, and besides not providing treatment, they charge exorbitant prices. I had to take my dog ​​to another place, and they treated her very well there. My dog ​​is still with me, unlike what the vet at Mohawk Alley Animal said. I don't recommend that place at all. People, take good care of your animals and be careful where you take your pets because they might end up hurting you. sleep
every person is very friendly and helpful in the process of taking care of my pooch.
The team of doctors are excellent and front  office too
Everyone here is so kind and patient and make me feel at ease when I am worried about my Cats. Highly recommend taking your pets here.
Everyone was very friendly. It was a quick visit and I was able to have all my questions answered. I appreciated the $25 first vet visit promotion

Great practice, has a couple of parking places which makes it much easier to find a spot. I like that you can book appointments with technicians really quickly when a full Vet visit isn't required. They look after my 4 yr old Pug who is my life.
i love mohawk alley! they're so kind and knowledgeable, and while they're popular in the community and busy, they always take get back to me quickly and take such good care of my pup!

Shout out to Dr Connor who was wonderful with our new rescue pup!  He was so kind and thorough during the examination, even finding the tiniest bump we thought we'd only notice.  Grateful to have found a kind vet to bring our dog to.  Plus the neuter cost was very reasonable.
Staff and doctor were super friendly and helpful. My cat was seen on time and well taken care of :)
Very helpful and kind staff

Love it here! Top care. Kind service. Not being rushed. Kindness. Thoughtful responses from vets. Easy to book. My little baby has come here for everything for 9 years. They even helped me understand what we needed for international travel.
Great service, kind, and answered all my questions. My pup is happy and healthy. Easy for scheduling, kindness from staff !

Wonderful service! I really appreciate the phone and online portal communication. I am grateful for the time that all the staff gave to me to thoroughly review everything and answer my questions. I feel confident about establishing care for my fur baby at Mohawk Alley.

Update 1/10/26:

I feel very taken care of here and trust everyone with my cat! I was so grateful to have the vet tech's help in sanitizing my carrier after Gracie peed in it, and their help wiping her fur clean. I also requested a demo for administering flea medicine and I now feel confident doing so. It was little things like this as well as the kindness from everyone that made the visit stress free and really took a load off. Thank you!

Gretchen Legaspi is a wonderful vet. She is very thorough with answering questions and she was very pleasant to speak with.
I felt Sage was in good hands.
Thank you to all your staff as well. They were all so kind.

Gretchen answering my questions as thoroughly as possible was what put me at ease with Sage's well-being.

Great service: I got an appointment quickly and the doctor as well as all the staff was friendly, professional and answered all my questions clearly. I appreciated the clear explanations on diagnosis and treatment

This was our cat Sam’s first visit to the 2162 W. Sunset Blvd clinic. He was a bit nervous since he used to be a stray and isn’t used to these kinds of visits. The staff was very kind and caring. Thank you, Dr. Ruby Jong, for your professionalism and compassion. I highly recommend this clinic for your pet’s check-up. 🐈🐕🐾 …
Thank you for the great rating! We're here to provide the best quality care and expertise, and are glad to see we succeeded. Our team appreciates you taking the time to leave us a review!
Great service overall. Online appointment widget is wonky so I just call the front desk. eInformative providers. Staff is always very good with my dog.

I came for a specialist dental evaluation. truly appreciated the warmth, clear communication, and thoughtful approach from everyone I met — it felt like a place where my cats would really be in good hands.

Fantastic first visit for my usually anxious and sometimes reactive husky lab, Kaia. Everyone from the techs to the vet was loving and patiently listened to my laundry list of questions and concerns. Feels so great to finally find a trusted vet in Los Angeles!

Friendly staff and a clean environment. Felt safe. The professional but caring approach that was taken to our pets for the concerns of the visit as well as health plans drafted for concerns found during exam.

I cannot recommend this clinic highly enough. Dr. Jong and her team have taken *amazing* care of my rescue dog (first via the rescue and then through me), who has severe anxiety during vet visits! She handled his neuter surgery so cleanly, you can't even see the scar.

The front desk at Mohawk is also well staffed, and everyone is so on the ball--I always received precise instructions ahead of time (like taking your pet through a different entrance if they might be contagious, etc.) and detailed bills/visit summaries afterward.

I will say that treatment here isn't cheap, but I've found it 1000% worth it (especially with vet insurance) for the organized communication and level of care, which are both top-notch.

I could not be happier to have Mohawk Alley as my dog's vet. The staff are friendly and compassionate. The vets and techs actually listen to me (not always the case with my previous vets) and I always feel like they are truly invested in and thoughtful about what's best for my dog.

Our dog has received nothing short of excellent care here, from the vet techs and front desk staff to the doctors. They have been swift in answering all of our questions, documentation/invoicing system is excellent and current, and we know our dog is in great hands.
Thank you for the wonderful rating! We take a lot of pride in delivering the best care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

I love the establishment, the cleanliness and I especially appreciated the staff being able to treat my dog without him being anxious, etc. Being able to treat my puppy with an ear infection and him not being anxious was very comforting.  also all the information that the healthcare provider gave me regarding administering meds etc.   And the cost was very reasonable.
They are always so extremely kind and helpful. They listen to our concerns and do their best to make our pets feel comfortable. Honestly the best vet experience I think I’ve ever had. We love them!

Lovely front desk staff
Doctor was helpful and listened to my concerns and answered my questions Front desk help
So far so good with my baby
The staff, doctors, front desk - everyone is AMAZING, caring, kind, understanding and just overall have great energy. All of the staff's kindness
They care for my precious animal and work with me to get him the best care. Helping get me on a once a year visit schedule.

This place is terrible and has gone downhill beyond measure. This used to be the pinnacle of veterinary offices, now I wouldn’t recommend Mohawk Alley to anyone. The doctors are all over the place and the medical records are poorly kept. (Ex: They have my 9-pound cat listed as 15.9 pounds). I have been waiting for Dr. Jong to call or email about my cat’s lab results since October 2. It is now October 20. I have left several messages over multiple days. I can’t imagine if this were an urgent situation— I can definitely see why other people have given this place one star.
I love Mohawk! Great service and sensitive physicians and we are always seen close to our appointment time.

We feel our new dog Cleo, who is a rescue, got excellent care at Mohawk. The vet took time to explain a lot of things about raising a puppy on a natural diet. One on one with the vet, their extensive knowledge.  Our dog is a 10 most old female German Shepherd rescue puppy.  There is a lot to learn and Mohawk was great.
Very helpful and caring! It never felt like they were in it for the money. It felt like they genuinely cared about my dogs well being.
While Tiggrrr won't admit it, his visit to Mohawk was perfect.

I had a great experience. The facility is clean and the lobby is welcoming. Everyone on the staff was helpful and nice. My new kitten and i received exceptional service. I appreciated how friendly and knowledgeable everyone was

I really appreciate the convenience of Sunday appointments and how quickly we were seen with such a short wait time. The vet took their time with us in the exam room which made the visit feel thorough and unhurried. The office itself was very clean and welcoming and I especially value the small alcove area for my reactive dog. It made the experience much less stressful.

I really did love Mohawk and trusted them until my dog Athena passed away. I felt let down by Mohawk. On 9/13/25, I took Athena for an emergency visit as she wasn't feeling well. Blood work and Xray's were done, paid almost $1300.00. Mohawk doctor told me my baby was fine, although her enzymes were a little elevated. a week and half later on 9/23/2025 my baby started seizing, I took her to MASH emergency hospital where she passed.  She has a severe infection. I felt like this should have be caught on the 9/13/25 visit. I feel the doctor could have done better. I feel guilty for not pushing for more. I will most definitely not take any pets to Mohawk as they have lost my trust. PLEASE MAKE SURE THEY TREAT YOUR PETS CORRECTLY, PUSH if you know your pets are not themselves. The staff if friendly but that's not enough for me.
Very kind and considerate staff!
Amazing service, friendly staff, very informative, great facilities the staff
The staff is really friendly and helpful. The staff gave our dogs 2 Kong toys & they put on the song "Expresso" for one of my dogs after I told them that he liked that song.
The care, kindness, and compassion that the staff and doctors exude is exactly what I want from a vet office. Thank you, Mohawk Alley!

We had a bit of an emergency with our pup on a Sunday. I was put on the wait list, received a call and they were able to see him that day. Staff is always friendly, Brooke was very personable and cared about our situation. Dr. Jong explored options for treatment with no pressure. Appreciate this place! Feels like everyone cares about us and our pets.
Thank you for the great rating! We're here to provide the best quality care and expertise, and are glad to see we succeeded. Our team appreciates you taking the time to leave us a review!
Really impressed with customer service as first time visitor. From beginning to end, i felt like part of family and vet was extremely knowledgeable
Amazing staff and doctors ! Highly recommend. They listen and don’t rush you
Mohawk Veterinary gives you top flight service, along with expert care of pets. I also like how they use tech to streamline all services.
We really appreciate the rating! We're here to be the best in veterinary care and are glad you had a great experience with us.

Been going here for years with my dogs, and continue to come despite moving to the west side. My two girls passed away within the last nine months and they saw a few different doctors and staff throughout the years. Dr. Pacifici was wonderful with them in their geriatric years.

I specifically continue to come because of how they have handled my little 5lb Chi. He was very spicy when I adopted him and now is just extremely scared. Dr. Pacifici is great with him and tech Vanessa is like a fairy godmother!! If you have a nervous dog please ask for Vanessa. She’s wonderful with him. I don’t know what I will do if she ever leaves!!
Wonderful and team at Mohawk, they're always very helpful and communicative when we come in. We really appreciate their dedication.
I was very pleased with the care and attention that my dog Chloe received at Mohawk Alley, as well as the discounted cost of the introductory appointment.
Had a great experience; everyone was very friendly and efficient! We appreciated everyone's kindness and attentiveness to our pets! Also provided price estimate and explanation that was very helpful
Quality care and attention from staff. I appreciate the ease of scheduling appointments and fast communication.
Really appreciated the speedy service and individualized attentive care

Absolutely Amazing PLACE!!! The entire staff is great! Practice manager Thea is so kind and so helpful. Roni is amazing. Reception team, all of you guys rock!! Dr legaspi has been working on my Rocky and shes amazing and she has been honest.. overall this place is where you would want your pets to be seen. The doctors are amazing.

Fantastic office. They're genuinely dedicated to the animals they treat. I couldn’t be more grateful for the care and support they gave us.

Also, check out K9 Loft next door for affordable grooming, boarding, and daycare
Very welcoming, understanding and informative!! They take care of my fur baby!!
Everyone is knowledgeable, professional and helpful! The vet was kind and caring with my pet (who is not the easiest to work with when scared)

My dog tries to drag me into Mohawk Alley every time we walk past (which is a few times a week). He loves the people here because they treat him so well. We've been coming here since I got him as a pup just under 2 years ago and have had nothing but 10/10 experiences. What we most appreciate is the thoughtful approach to pets and people.

Good vets however wait is sometimes long and medication is marked up.  I usually order medication from only Rx instead of the hospital.

== Update: Feb 4, 2023 ==
I've downgraded the ratings from 4-stars down to 2-stars, it seems that they make it quite difficult to order from allivet.com.  I've had several medications ordered through allivet.com and they try to contact Mohawk Alley Animal Hospital several times to verify the Rx however  Mohawk Alley seems to be quite unresponsive.  This has occurred several times and I suspect they're doing this to discourage internet Rx orders so that medication is purchased through Mohawk Alley at a very inflated rate.

== Update: Jul 3, 2025 ==
Some things never change, they still seem to drag their feet when it comes to RX approvals when ordering from other pharmacies.  Same issue trying to refill prescription from allivet.com.  I had called Allivet and they tell me it's pending RX from Mohawk Alley.

They take such good care of my girl Honey here. Thank you for all that you do! I also appreciate how they will help me determine which of the recommended procedures are really necessary. Of course, they’re always going to give you the option to be extra cautious. However, that doesn’t always fit the budget. So it’s really helpful to get a doctor that is real with you. Not all of them are like this here, but there are some good ones! We recently met with Dr. Traylor and she was amazing!

Receptionists are super friendly and enthusiastic about the work they do. Technicians were quick, the dog loves them. I loved when the receptionist came around to say hello to my dog, she was really kind and helpful.
The professional and caring staff, along with great veterinary care, keeps me coming back! Thanks for caring for my cat as if he were your own.

My first visit to check my cat’s teeth wasn’t the greatest.  I arrived early and was taken into a small exam room with a closed door where I sat for over 40 minutes, it was a hot day so I opened a door adjacent to the exam room that led to the parking lot just to get some air.  While standing with the door propped open, a female employee with dark brown hair (didn’t realize it was the vet) appeared with a frown waving the air, I asked if something was wrong, she scowled and said that I was letting flies in.  I soon learned she was our vet and was relieved to finally get the exam going.  The vet was informative and seemed very competent but I found her to be cold and impersonal.  In the end, I wanted my cat to be in capable hands and decided to go through with her dental extractions and cleaning.  The surgeon / vet (assuming a different vet based on her voice) cleaning and extracting my cat’s teeth, couldn’t have been nicer.  She explained everything in detail and brought up an unrelated chronic issue my formerly stray cat has had ever since she showed up at my house.  She offered a couple of options to address this condition that other vets chalked up to being unfixable.  During my cat’s operation, the veterinarian continued to keep me abreast of the multiple extractions.  I haven’t met the vet who operated on my cat in person, but I can say she is caring, thoughtful and good at what she does.  My senior cat is doing great one day after multiple extractions.  The follow up on the app with multiple check-ins is another great factor.  The team asks specific questions, has she eaten is she listless, etc. making it easy to respond.
I love this vet. I can't thank you all enough for taking such great care of my biological child, Luna Tuna Chicken Bhuna. Everyone's kindness, patience, and thorough care

The space is beautiful and very welcoming. The staff was so friendly and helpful and everything ran on time. The Doctor was excellent and answered all of are concerns as well as offered different estimates which was so helpful. And we love the operating systems used to communicate and how you receive texts and emails with appointment times and test results. Really great business!

I love this vet. I have previously gone here for my bosses cats and so appreciated the staff and how coordinated everything was. I live in Culver but it’s worth the drive to go here! I brought my cat in who wasn’t too excited but it was an easy and gentle process. I appreciate the staff and they send documents by email which helps me so much! Also they’ve sent pictures of the cats before while in treatment which I love!!

My poor doggy has cancer but the people here helped me to make a more informed decision. The doctor that I had was kind and honest about the situation. I would recommend this vet if you don't mind the $100 exam fee they have a much better fee for newcomers
Kind, knowledgeable staff with flexible mindsets and fair prices. Would bring my pet back!
Truly caring and dedicated service that was efficient, effective, and reasonably priced. I most appreciated how understanding the team was around my rescue pups' trauma and quirks. Highly recommend!

Our fur baby, Noori, has been going to Mohawk Alley Animal Hospital since she was a puppy and we have been grateful for the team in taking care of her medical needs. Kudos to the team and everything you all do to make her and us happy. Placing our trust and confidence to your team means the whole world to us and we appreciate you all! Thank you, thank you!

We've always been treated excellently at Mohawk Alley, even when the reasons we've had to go there haven't been the best. Our dog has always had the best care, and when the time came to let our cat go we were supported and cared for in the most beautiful way. Kind staff, easy to make appointments

I came here a few years ago, and never went back, but I thought it was important to tell my story. My dog was having blood and mucous in her bowels, and all the tests came back normal. They did an ultrasound and said her GI tract looked normal, and her spleen looked normal, but slightly enlarged, and asked to do a biopsy.  I took pause, it didn't feel right, and said No. The Vet started really pressuring me to do the biopsy, but I kept saying No. I learned from two other Vetinarians that doing a biopsy on a spleen was a very risky procedure because of bleeding out. If the animal indicated sickness with Spleen, and the  Spleen was diseased, the best option would be to just remove the Spleen. I honestly felt they just wanted to jack the bill than do what was right by my dog. I did repeat another ultrasound 6 months later at another facility, and her Spleen was normal. Thank the stars, I listened to my gut. Back to the blood and mucous in my dog's stool. They couldn't find anything wrong and the Vet suggested putting my dog on Flagyl for the rest of her life. I said, Let me think about that. After doing my own research, I suspected she had a food allergy, and discovered the culprit was beef. Stopped giving my dog beef, and she was fine. I asked the Vet if a food allergy could cause blood and mucous in stools, and she said Yes. So WHY didn't she bring that up ? She wanted to put my dog on high powered antibiotics for the rest of her life, and I had to figure out what was wrong.  So no, I never went back, and have great Vetinarians now.

I can't believe I'm writing this as I had previously written a glowing review about this place but I called today just to find out that my senior dog's veterinarian is no longer on staff and that there is absolutely no way to get a message to her even though she still "occasionally" does relief work for them.

I want to start off saying we have been coming here for four years, the staff have always been very nice and I have no personal issues with them. I have an issue with how the business is run and how that dampens the overall experience in feeling well cared for.

I made an appointment online, was not made aware it was curbside until after it was already booked. My cat had been peeing every 15-20 minutes and I wanted to make sure she was ok. Consultation was good, the doctor was thorough with her explanations, but then they come back with a treatment plan giving you an idea of what your bill is going to look like. The first one they came back with was well over $500. That included an advanced urine analysis, gabapentin, and antibiotics. I am not well off financially right now but I want to make sure my cat is taken care of, so I express that to them. The tech then goes back to the doctor and returns with the gabapentin amount lowered and a less conclusive urine analysis. This lowers the bill by about $200. This is still a very hefty bill for me right now and I’m already nervous given my cat seems to be sick, so I don’t muster up the courage to push back another time.

After leaving a urine sample with them, I go home and have more questions in regards to timeline so I follow up via the chat. Someone responds and says they will ask the dr, I then follow up letting them know my cat was having more issues now, then I never heard back. Two days later I missed a call. I immediately call back and get put on hold for 7 minutes. I finally gave up because I saw the dr left a voicemail and I was at work. She let me know that there was no uti but there were crystals which can be caused by dehydration. No chance to talk with her directly and I’m left feeling confused on the prognosis. My cats have a water fountain and eat wet food, so it’s just not adding up, but again not able to talk through it with the vet.

I understand being proactive with the meds, in a way, but every time we’ve had a visit with them, I’m left feeling ripped off. I feel taken advantage of given my emotional state and hate that I have to haggle with them in order to get a diagnosis. Then to top it all off I still didn’t get to have a conversation about it and am left with $100 worth of medicine we did not need.

I guess this a larger systemic problem all in all, but just writing this in case you are considering coming here and you are not their target clientele.
